name: Continuous Report Blueprint
description: Composition blueprint for single-scroll vertical reports: semantic section flow, bento card architecture, KPI callouts, comparison tables — no style rules (zone TOP / template)
prompt:
TEMPLATE BLUEPRINT (Structural Composition & Component Hierarchy — No Style Rules):

1. DOCUMENT FLOW:
   - One <main> wrapping an intro <header> (document title, eyebrow, audience/date meta, mini table of contents with in-page anchors) followed by modular <section data-section="{{section_id}}"> containers in outline order.
   - Sections stack vertically with auto-height; never fixed-height panels, never page breaks, never slide chrome.

2. CARD & COMPONENT ARCHITECTURE:
   - Content units are self-contained cards: <article class="card" data-section="{{section_id}}">.
   - Peer cards arrange into auto-wrapping bento grids.
   - Key metrics render as KPI callout blocks (<div class="kpi"> — value + label + context line).
   - Tradeoffs and comparisons render as clean 2-column <table> blocks.
   - Every section heading carries an id matching its table-of-contents anchor.

3. CONTINUATION CONTRACT:
   - Emit sections strictly in outline order so an interrupted pass resumes with '继续生成剩余部分' without re-emitting delivered sections.
   - On continuation, never reorder, renumber, or re-emit delivered sections.

4. DENSITY SLOTS (structure only):
   - Each bullet item opens with a bold lead-in phrase wrapped in <strong> (first 2–4 words).
   - Every card carries substantive data or an explicit takeaway — no conversational filler, no empty placeholder text.
